decision: Primary target is Sales; Customers is a secondary target with its own model.
reason: Dashboard needs both outputs; Customers is not in test.csv, so it cannot feed the sales model.

decision: Main forecast horizon is 42 days; the same pipeline covers the 48-day test window.
reason: Brief asks for six weeks ahead; test.csv spans 48 days.

decision: Final holdout = last 42 labelled days of train, scored once after all choices are locked.
reason: Gives an honest estimate of forecast error; test.csv has no Sales to score against.

decision: Three earlier rolling 42-day validation windows with common cut-offs across stores.
reason: Tests stability across time without touching the final holdout.

decision: Model log1p(Sales); loss = RMSE on the log scale; primary metric = RMSPE on positive-sales days; MAE and RMSE secondary.
reason: Sales is right-skewed and finance cares about percentage error; log RMSE behaves like relative error.

decision: Predict zero when a store is closed; train on open days only.
reason: All closed days have zero sales; including them would distort the model.

decision: Do not cap Sales with IQR rules; treat outliers only with evidence from store histories.
reason: High sales may be genuine holiday or promotion peaks the model must learn.

decision: No actual future Customers or Sales may be used as forecast inputs; history is allowed only before the forecast origin.
reason: Prevents leakage; Customers is not available in test.csv.

decision: Use a shared LSTM across stores (store and calendar inputs) as the main deep learning design.
reason: More practical than 1,115 separate models and runs in Colab.

decision: Build the app with Streamlit and host it on a free platform.
reason: Brief allows Streamlit; free hosting is sufficient for the project.

decision: Unit tests, CI/CD and Docker are optional; list as pending if skipped.
reason: Not required by the brief; avoid claiming work that was not done.

decision: Settings (paths, seed 42, horizon, tracking names) live in src/config.py; one logger and one style module are shared by notebook and app.
reason: A single source of truth keeps results, figures and the app consistent.

decision: MLflow uses a local SQLite store (mlflow.db); models are logged as pickles (cloudpickle); trial run kept in a separate 'setup-check' experiment.
reason: Supports the model registry and multiple model versions; pickles match the brief's .pkl requirement.

decision: DVC tracks the whole data/ folder as one unit with tagged versions (data-v1-raw, v2-cleaned, v3-features); the local store path is kept out of Git.
reason: The history of one pointer file shows multiple data versions for the DVC screenshot.

decision: Two requirements files: requirements.txt (app only) and requirements-dev.txt (notebook and tracking).
reason: Keeps hosting installs small and fast while the notebook stays fully reproducible.

decision: Figures are saved as 'Figure <section>.<n>' in figures/ and tables as 'Table <section>.<n>' in outputs/tables/, all in the shared palette.
reason: Notebook, report and slides can cite the same numbered items.

decision: Models will be saved as dd-mm-yyyy-HH-MM-SS.pkl using config.MODEL_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.
reason: Matches the brief and lets predictions be traced to a model.

decision: A minimal Streamlit page is deployed early as an environment check.
reason: Finds hosting and dependency problems before the final week.
